Key Learning Goals (2026-11-08):
1. How to become an AI Engineer in 2026: Agent orchestration, local models, RAG/vector architecture, eval harnesses, full-stack product engineering.
2. How Model Thinking Works Deep Down: Reasoning models (o1/DeepSeek R1/Kimi), hidden chain-of-thought, test-time compute scaling, RL with verifiable rewards (GRPO), and search trees (MCTS).
Hardware & Quantum Deep Dives (2026-11-08):
3. AI Silicon & Chips: GPU memory-bandwidth bottlenecks, Google TPUs, Groq LPUs (SRAM), and Apple Neural Engine.
4. RSA & Quantum Computing: Public-key cryptography, Shor's algorithm breaking RSA/ECC, and the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) standards.
Business & Unit Economics (2026-11-09):
5. AI Coding Subscription Economics: Why tools like GitHub Copilot (/mo) and Claude Pro are dramatically cheaper than paying per-token API prices (prompt caching, speculative decoding, loss-leader growth subsidies, and 80/20 user compute pooling).
